basis: Saved validated shapes and pinned eager implementation, not a new execution or measured primitive throughput
not_counted: SRQ elementwise operations, unpacking/conversion, GELU/norm/softmax, allocation, memory traffic and observer overhead

host_cpu.reason: Hardware flags known; no primitive/backend profiler captured. Lack of BF16 ISA does not identify the executed kernel or prove sole bottleneck.

saved_runtime.IO_reason: Guard captured free capacity, not process read/write counters; cannot retrospectively claim zero IO waiting.

limitations: No per-module timings or completed output; static FLOP counts are cost descriptors, not achieved throughput or exact completion-time estimates. No numerical/quality verdict.
